# UnleeshAI (UNLEESH)

> UnleeshAI (wordmark UNLEESH) is a remote web studio serving clients across the US. It designs and hand-codes custom websites and landing pages, then grows their visibility and conversion with SEO, AEO and AIO, content, and sales funnels.

- Website: https://unleeshai.com/
- Email: hello@unleeshai.com
- Location: Remote studio, serving clients across the United States
- Founded: 2026
- Services: Custom website design and development, Landing pages, SEO, AEO and AIO, Sales funnels, Blog and content writing, Traffic generation, Website optimization
- Typical project: 2 to 4 days from agreed brief to launch (3 on average), fixed-price quote once requirements are known
- Pricing: a five-page website starts at $499
- Portfolio note: the live websites listed below are real shipped client sites; the ten case studies are self-initiated studio concept projects, not client commissions

## Main pages

- [UnleeshAI | Custom Websites, SEO and AI Search Visibility](https://unleeshai.com/): UnleeshAI builds custom, hand-coded websites and landing pages, then gets them found on Google and in AI answers. SEO, AEO, content and funnels included.
- [About UnleeshAI: Remote Web Design and SEO Studio](https://unleeshai.com/about.html): How UnleeshAI works: a remote studio for custom websites, SEO, AI search and funnels, run on a six-phase process from first call to launch and growth.
- [Work: Live Sites & Web Design Cases | UnleeshAI](https://unleeshai.com/work.html): Live websites UnleeshAI has built and shipped, plus ten concept flagships across ten sectors: hand-coded sites, generated imagery and scroll-driven motion.
- [Labs: AI Visual & Web Motion Experiments | UnleeshAI](https://unleeshai.com/lab.html): UnleeshAI Labs: 25 experiments in web motion design, AI motion imagery and commercial image generation, filterable by stream with a captioned lightbox.
- [Contact UnleeshAI: Start a Website or SEO Project](https://unleeshai.com/contact.html): Send UnleeshAI a brief for a website, landing page, SEO or AI search project. Five-page sites from $499, most live in 2 to 4 days. Replies in two working days.
- [Journal: Web Design, Motion & AI Visual Notes | UnleeshAI](https://unleeshai.com/blog.html): The UnleeshAI journal: field notes on web design, scroll motion, AI product imagery and brand strategy, written by the studio while the work was still fresh.

## Live websites built by the studio

- [Florida Land Brand Site](https://goldenrp.land/): Real Estate · Land Sales. The full brand site for an owner-financed land company: parcel listings, a how-it-works flow, buyer guides, a blog, an FAQ and a VIP lead form, built on Next.js with a live content database.
- [Search Landing Page](https://goldenrpland.com/florida-land/): Real Estate · SEO. A long-form landing page written to rank for owner-financed land searches: a bank-versus-owner comparison, the payment numbers set out plainly, an FAQ and a free land guide download.
- [Conversion Landing Page](https://goldenrpland.com/owner-financed-land-florida/): Real Estate · Lead Gen. A fast single-offer page built to convert: one clear promise, trust badges, a quick-facts panel and a 30-second land credit claim form above the fold.

## Concept case studies

- [Lumen Skincare](https://unleeshai.com/work_lumen.html): Beauty Flagship. Redefining clean beauty: a bespoke digital experience blending editorial layouts with an organic palette.
- [Nocturne Dining](https://unleeshai.com/work_nocturne.html): Hospitality. A tasting menu told in candlelight: reservation flow, menu narrative and cellar archive in one continuous scroll.
- [Wilder Camp](https://unleeshai.com/work_wilder.html): Outdoor Brand. Expedition-grade gear presented at blue hour, with lantern light doing the selling.
- [Ironflow Lubricants](https://unleeshai.com/work_ironflow.html): B2B Industrial. Heavy industry through a macro lens: viscosity, sheen and torque as brand assets.
- [Cane & Form](https://unleeshai.com/work_caneform.html): Furniture & Living. Rattan weave under raking light: a craft catalogue with long shadows and longer patience.
- [Pull Noodle Bar](https://unleeshai.com/work_pullnoodle.html): F&B Retail. Hand-pulled craft caught mid-air: flour dust in a single shaft of light.
- [Axiom Precision](https://unleeshai.com/work_axiom.html): Manufacturing. CNC tolerances as brand language: titanium, coolant spray and sparks of white light.
- [Forgeline Steel](https://unleeshai.com/work_forgeline.html): Industrial Group. Foundry glow as the only colour in a monochrome world.
- [Clara Aesthetics](https://unleeshai.com/work_clara.html): Medical Aesthetics. Clinical calm behind frosted glass: a corridor of soft light and quiet confidence.
- [Helios Energy](https://unleeshai.com/work_helios.html): Renewable Energy. Night arrays reflecting the moon: solar told through geometry and silence.

## Journal

- [Why your hero section is costing you clients](https://unleeshai.com/journal_hero-section-costing-clients.html) (2026-08-18, Web Design): The first viewport is a job interview that lasts three seconds. Most premium brands fail it by saying everything at once.
- [One key light: the whole aesthetic explained](https://unleeshai.com/journal_one-key-light.html) (2026-08-02, AI Visuals): Every image we ship is lit from one direction. Here is why that single constraint does most of the work.
- [AI product photography that passes for a five-figure shoot](https://unleeshai.com/journal_ai-product-photography-five-figure-shoot.html) (2026-07-22, AI Visuals): Generated imagery is only cheap if you accept the first result. The craft is in the second, third and fourteenth.
- [Scroll is a story, not a scrollbar](https://unleeshai.com/journal_scroll-is-a-story.html) (2026-07-10, Motion): Scroll-driven motion earns its place when it changes what the reader understands, not just what they see.
- [The case against page builders for premium brands](https://unleeshai.com/journal_case-against-page-builders.html) (2026-06-28, Strategy): A template is a decision someone else made about how your brand should feel. For most businesses that is fine. For a premium brand it is the whole problem.
- [Motion tokens: a design system for time](https://unleeshai.com/journal_motion-tokens.html) (2026-06-15, Motion): Colour and type have tokens. Motion should too. Here is the small set of durations and curves that runs every page we build.
- [Dark mode is not a theme, it is a stage](https://unleeshai.com/journal_dark-mode-is-a-stage.html) (2026-06-01, Web Design): Designing on near-black is not inverting a light site. It is deciding that the content is the only thing lit.
- [What a brand audit actually finds (and what it costs to skip one)](https://unleeshai.com/journal_brand-audit-findings.html) (2026-05-20, Strategy): Every project we take on begins with looking before making. The temptation is always to skip it. Here is what gets skipped.
- [WebGL: when it earns its place and when it is vanity](https://unleeshai.com/journal_webgl-when-it-earns-its-place.html) (2026-05-06, Motion): A shader is the most expensive way to render a rectangle. Sometimes the rectangle deserves it.
- [Typography carries the menu: lessons from a candlelit concept](https://unleeshai.com/journal_typography-carries-the-menu.html) (2026-04-22, Concept Notes): On the Nocturne Dining concept there is almost no imagery. What holds the page is type set the way a menu is read.
- [Seamless loops: the craft of ambient video backgrounds](https://unleeshai.com/journal_seamless-loops.html) (2026-04-08, AI Visuals): A background loop should be invisible. The moment the reader notices the cut, it has become a distraction.
- [Negative space sells: the economics of restraint](https://unleeshai.com/journal_negative-space-sells.html) (2026-03-25, Strategy): Empty space on a page looks like waste to a spreadsheet and like confidence to a customer. Only one of them is buying.
- [From moodboard to motion in three days](https://unleeshai.com/journal_moodboard-to-motion-three-days.html) (2026-03-11, Process): The vibe workflow: how a taste-led loop replaces the six-week approval chain without lowering the bar.
- [Industrial brands deserve cinema too](https://unleeshai.com/journal_industrial-brands-deserve-cinema.html) (2026-02-26, Concept Notes): Machining, lubricants, steel. The sectors with the most visually extraordinary work are the ones that show it worst.
- [The preloader is the first scene of the film](https://unleeshai.com/journal_preloader-first-scene.html) (2026-02-12, Motion): A loading screen is a second of undivided attention. Most sites spend it on a spinner.
- [Launching UNLEESH Labs: our public sketchbook](https://unleeshai.com/journal_launching-unleesh-labs.html) (2026-01-28, Studio): Twenty-five experiments in web motion and generated imagery, published as they are made. Not portfolio pieces. Sketches.
